Five Borough Bicycle Club Day Rides

New York, NY · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

Five Borough Bicycle Club Day Rides is a road and social group ride in New York, NY. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 10:30 am. About 16–52 miles, beginner 'Happy Face' rides up to fast-paced rides. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner 'Happy Face' rides up to fast-paced rides. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @5bbcnyc the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Five Borough Bicycle Club Day Rides group ride

Leader-led day rides all over the five boroughs and nearby. September 2026 had a Bronx perimeter ride, a Staten Island loop, and food rides to Arthur Avenue and Teaneck. Leaders use a point-drop-sweep system so nobody gets lost. The calendar lists distance and start for each ride.
